fb_landlord.text: Welcome to the Hawes. Robert Louis Stevenson sat in here and put the place in Kidnapped: young David Balfour is lured from this inn on to a ship bound for the Carolinas.
Fancy a go at the quiz? Questions on the whole of Scotland. Losers buy the crisps.

fb_drinker.text: Forty years I've watched that bridge out the window. Trains go over every few minutes. I wave. They don't wave back. Rude, trains.
My granny said the rivets were counted on the day it opened: six and a half million. The last one was gold. They say. I've never found it. I've looked.
